totals.sql: select "id", (SELECT count(*)::text FROM "user_relation" WHERE "relation_id"="id" AND "category"='product' AND "type"='collect'), (SELECT count(*)::text FROM "user_relation" WHERE "relation_id"="id" AND "category"='product' AND "type"='like'), (SELECT sum("stock")::text FROM "store_product_attr_value" WHERE "product_id"="id" AND "type"=0), (SELECT count(*)::text FROM "store_visit" WHERE "product_id"="id" AND "product_type"='product') from "store_product" where "store_product"."id" in ($1, $2)

listWhere.sql:
select "id", "pid", "type", "product_type", "relation_id", "mer_id", "image", "recommend_image", "slider_image", "store_name", "store_info", "keyword", "bar_code", "cate_id", "price", "settle_price", "vip_price", "ot_price", "delivery_type", "freight", "postage", "temp_id", "unit_name", "sort", "star", "collect", "ficti", "sales", "stock", "is_show", "is_hot", "is_benefit", "is_best", "is_new", "add_time", "is_postage", "is_verify", "is_del", "mer_use", "give_integral", "cost", "is_seckill", "is_bargain", "is_good", "is_sub", "is_vip", "browse", "code_path", "soure_link", "video_open", "video_link", "spec_type", "activity", "spu", "label_id", "command_word", "recommend_list", "brand_id", "brand_com", "code", "is_vip_product", "is_presale_product", "presale_start_time", "presale_end_time", "presale_day", "auto_on_time", "auto_off_time", "custom_form", "system_form_id", "is_support_refund", "store_label_id", "ensure_id", "specs", "specs_id", "is_limit", "limit_type", "limit_num", "refusal", "is_police", "is_sold" from "store_product" where ("store_product"."is_show" = $1 and "store_product"."is_del" = $2 and "store_product"."is_verify" = $3 and "store_product"."type" = $4 and "store_product"."relation_id" = $5 and EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "store_product_relation" WHERE "store_product_relation"."product_id"="store_product"."id"
    AND "store_product_relation"."type"=$6 AND "store_product_relation"."relation_id" in ($7)) and "store_product"."brand_id" in ($8) and EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "store_product_relation" WHERE "store_product_relation"."product_id"="store_product"."id"
    AND "store_product_relation"."type"=$9 AND "store_product_relation"."relation_id" in ($10)) and EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "store_product_relation" WHERE "store_product_relation"."product_id"="store_product"."id"
    AND "store_product_relation"."type"=$11 AND "store_product_relation"."relation_id" in ($12)) and ("store_product"."id"::text ILIKE $13 or "store_product"."keyword" ILIKE $14 or "store_product"."store_name" ILIKE $15 or "store_product"."store_info" ILIKE $16 or "store_product"."bar_code" ILIKE $17 or EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "store_product_attr_value" WHERE "store_product_attr_value"."product_id"="store_product"."id" AND "store_product_attr_value"."bar_code"=$18)))

    AND "store_product_relation"."type"=$6 AND "store_product_relation"."relation_id" in ($7)) and "store_product"."brand_id" in ($8) and EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "store_product_relation" WHERE "store_product_relation"."product_id"="store_product"."id"
    AND "store_product_relation"."type"=$9 AND "store_product_relation"."relation_id" in ($10)) and EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "store_product_relation" WHERE "store_product_relation"."product_id"="store_product"."id"
    AND "store_product_relation"."type"=$11 AND "store_product_relation"."relation_id" in ($12)) and ("store_product"."id"::text ILIKE $13 or "store_product"."keyword" ILIKE $14 or "store_product"."store_name" ILIKE $15 or "store_product"."store_info" ILIKE $16 or "store_product"."bar_code" ILIKE $17 or EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "store_product_attr_value" WHERE "store_product_attr_value"."product_id"="store_product"."id" AND "store_product_attr_value"."bar_code"=$18)))
